notes: careers.slb.com/job-listing is a Coveo Atomic search page (searchHub CoveoJobsHub, pipeline ATSJobsPipeline, source "ATS_Jobs_Source - Prod", 1,098 postings). Results are served by POST https://schlumbergerproduction0cs2zrh7.org.coveo.com/rest/search/v2?organizationId=schlumbergerproduction0cs2zrh7 with the bearer token embedded in the listing page and a JSON body: q (keyword), cq='@source=="ATS_Jobs_Source - Prod"', aq (facet filters), sortCriteria, firstResult, numberOfResults. The page exposes Job Category, Country and Experience Level facets plus Relevance/Title/Oldest/Newest sort expressions; there is no title-search facet, no workplace-type facet and no city facet. This is a Coveo front end, not Workday.
